title: int:Market
description: A single energy market slot defining the trading window and delivery period. Subclass of cim:MarketDocument.

marketId.description: Primary identifier. IRI: int:marketId. UUID v4.

communityId.description: FK to Community. IRI: int:communityId. UUID v4.

openingTime.description: Market opens for order submission. IRI: int:openingTime. ISO 8601 with timezone. Must be < closingTime.

closingTime.description: Market closes for order submission. IRI: int:closingTime. ISO 8601 with timezone. Must be > openingTime and <= deliveryStartTime.

deliveryStartTime.description: Start of energy delivery period. IRI: int:deliveryStartTime. ISO 8601 with timezone.

deliveryEndTime.description: End of energy delivery period. IRI: int:deliveryEndTime. ISO 8601 with timezone. Must be > deliveryStartTime.

matchingAlgorithm.description: Market clearing algorithm applied to this slot. IRI: int:matchingAlgorithm.

createdAt.description: Record creation timestamp. IRI: int:createdAt. ISO 8601 with timezone.
